title: Higher-order social networks 的測量與動力學
statement: pairwise graph無法表示group-mediated interactions時，如何由真實higher-order data估hypergraph/simplicial dynamics並比較pairwise approximation loss。
known_result: 2026 Scientific Data A Blue Start提供39.7M accounts、2.4B pairwise follows與365.8K starter-pack groups，直接連接pairwise與higher-order social ties。
open_gap: group membership semantics、selection into curated groups、temporal evolution與sampling/API bias。
first_task: 只用可公開合法的小sample/synthetic replica，比較pairwise projection vs hypergraph contagion/community outputs。
evaluator: prediction error、information loss、higher-order interaction effect、sampling sensitivity。
validation_limits: starter-pack共組不等於實際密切互動；不推斷個人政治/敏感屬性。
completion_criterion: higher-order model對held-out group-mediated outcomes有可重現增益，且效果不由sampling artifact解釋。
screening_note: 2026-09-28 初始有界文獻篩查。社會科學結果高度依賴population、platform、time period與identification assumptions；每輪需重查版本與反證。
screening_queries: higher order social network dataset 2026 Blue Start

sources.title: A Blue Start: A large-scale pairwise and higher-order social network dataset
